description.value: The Island Grind is an independent, community-rooted cafe in Campbell River, BC, founded in 2017 by Evan Falck and Robyn Yow, with two locations in the city. The cafe partners with Discovery Coffee from Victoria, Campbell River's Stonehouse Teas, and Daves' Bakery to serve specialty espresso drinks, smoothies, teas, and a daily rotating selection of fresh breakfast and lunch items made in-house. Touring cyclists will find a full savoury food menu — wraps, sandwiches, salads, paninis, and soup — alongside baked goods and a strong local community identity.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Island Grind is an active, independent cafe operating two locations in Campbell River, BC (Timberline Village at 801 Hilchey Rd #104-105 and Discovery Harbour at Unit 136 - 1416 Island Highway); the OSM pin does not indicate which location it represents. The menu and catering pages explicitly confirm vegetarian and gluten-free options and individually wrapped grab-and-go food items. No website content addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific infrastructure.
